Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Read or save one listed trial PDF. Reads up to 25 MiB and 100 pages, one 6144-byte fragment at a time.

file.description: Exact filename from the registry manifest; never a URL or inferred path.

find.description: Case-insensitive phrase to find, with PDF page numbers.

replace.description: Replace an existing file only when explicitly requested.

save.description: Save original bytes to a caller-owned file or folder instead of reading text.

section_offset.description: Zero-based text part or match offset.

title: TrialDocumentGet
